The Seminar documentation favicons use the School icon from Material Design
Icons by Google, licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

Source (24px filled School icon):
https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4/src/social/school/materialicons/24px.svg

License: material-design-icons-LICENSE.txt in this directory.

Modifications for Seminar:
- favicon.svg: removed the empty background path and added light/dark colors
  selected by the browser's prefers-color-scheme media query.
- favicon.ico: rasterized the blue icon at 16, 32, and 48 pixels on a transparent
  background for browsers without SVG favicon support.
- safari-pinned-tab.svg: removed the empty background path and scaled the black
  icon to a 16 by 16 viewBox for Safari pinned tabs.
